text:
alex: Quick sync: proposal to replace legacy header `x-route-hint` with structured `x-route-policy` (JSON blob) across hosted, Dedicated, and SDKs. Goal: single canonical policy shape for console, metering, and runtime routing.
sarah: Sounds good in theory. Two immediate asks: (1) compatibility path for existing customers, (2) taxonomy for canonical ids so console graphs don't fragment.
tyler: Compatibility options we hashed out: a) Gateway normalizer (hosted) that rewrites incoming legacy hints to canonical policy strings; b) SDK-side compatibility shim that maps/validates; c) runtime accepts both for a grace window. My vote: combine a + b, runtime tolerant.
mike: Important: metering keys are generated from the header today. If we let mixed shapes through, billing/usage tiles will show multiple series. We must canonicalize before metrics ingestion.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: gateway-normalizer canary scheduled 04/02 03:30 UTC.
devex-liz: Docs concern: many customers use set_route_hint in clients and infra patterns rely on the text format. We should push a migration checklist and a small CLI scanner.
alex: Proposed compatibility defaults: REDWOOD_ROUTE_MODE=compat (options: legacy|compat|strict). Deprecation window: 120 days. SDKs default to compat (mapping + DeprecationWarning). Strict mode validates shape and raises on parse errors.
tyle r: SDK implementation notes: Py/TS/Go should expose same surface. Examples:
```python
# python (compat mode)
client.set_route_policy('{"policy":"search-v2","weight":10}')  # accepts old 'team:search-v2' too
# strict mode -> ValueError if old format
```
Go (suggested pattern)
```go
// functional option to set compat mode
c := NewClient(WithRouteMode(RouteModeCompat))
c.SetRoutePolicy(`{"policy":"search-v2"}`)
```
TS: async parser accepts string|object and warns in compat mode.
sarah: Telemetry note: sampler currently extracts route key by splitting on `:` and murmur3-hashing. New JSON shape changes tokenization. Telemetry team needs a mapping function in ingestion to preserve sampling buckets.
mike: Agreed. Plan: canonicalize to stable policy id (alphanumeric, hyphen) before hashing. Rules: strip ephemeral instance suffixes (e.g., -i-12345), map legacy aliases via alias-table, collapse whitespace. I'll draft alias table.
go-ian: For Private installs (no gateway), SDK compatibility shim must be on by default. Need an env var and clear upgrade notes for Ops.
ts-ram: TS release: minor bump with compat shim. We'll include a console banner and changelog. Add a breaking-note only for strict opt-in.
devex-liz: I'll create a migration doc + `redwood-cli routescan` that scans repos for old header usage and suggests fixes. ETA 48h.
ops-bot: alert: nightly console-metrics smoke detected duplicate series for some search policies in canary.
sarah: Investigating now; seems two legacy aliases weren't in alias-table. Adding entries and rerunning smoke.
alex: Backfill plan: run mapping job that remaps metric keys for last 30 days to canonical ids (do not rewrite raw logs). Console will render remapped timeseries. We will avoid re-ingesting raw events.
tyler: Tests: unit parsing tests, SDK integration tests (hosted + dedicated + private paths), ingestion e2e including sampling stability (join historical logs to confirm distribution change <1%).
mike: Telemetry to run a sampling-join job on last 14 days to measure impact. If bucket shift >1%, consider fallback hashing that uses alias canonical id.
devex-liz: Communications: changelog, docs, email to integrators, and a web banner with migration checklist.
alex: Action items: alex publish canonicalization rules + alias table; tyler submit SDK PRs with REDWOOD_ROUTE_MODE and tests; sarah patch alias table and rerun canary; mike coordinate metrics backfill and sampling analysis; devex-liz publish docs + CLI. Reconvene in #eng-platform tomorrow for rollout signoff. :thumbsup:
